mapping.summary: Tracks shipping containers and voyages from booking to receipt, with transit accruals and freight allocation.
claims: Records voyages with carrier, vessel, ports, ETD/ETA, bill of lading and booking reference
Container register keyed on ISO 6346 numbers with seal, weights and dates
Purchase, sales and transfer lines link to container bookings; edits flag the booking for review
Optional container column on standard purchase and sales lines pages
Departure or arrival of a movement posts the linked shipments and receipts
Handles partial arrivals and actual arrived quantities with over-receipt tolerance
Month-end goods-in-transit accrual that reverses on arrival without touching vendor ledger
Allocates item charges across container lines by weight or volume
Records packing specification per container and reconciles it
Role centre cues for planned, booked, in-transit and review work
Freight allocation across vendors or currencies is blocked by default
No other apps or external services needed; telemetry can be switched off
BC online version 28.1 or later, Essentials or Premium
